hero.lead: Quorum records your meeting in the browser. Shortly afterwards the full transcript and a set of minutes in your own outline are waiting for you. You listen instead of writing.
hero.reach: Nothing to install, runs on phone and desktop.

record.title: Start recording
record.body: Tap record as the meeting begins and put your phone in the middle of the table, or leave the laptop open. There is nothing else to do.

read.title: Read every word
read.body: The full transcript is ready shortly after the meeting. You can search it, jump to any moment, and the text follows along word by word as it plays.

share.title: Pass the minutes on
share.body: Quorum sums the meeting up in the sections you need — an overview, the decisions, the action items. You set that outline once, as a template.

privacy.title: What is said here is nobody else's business.
privacy.ownership: Everything Quorum records and writes belongs in your account and nowhere else. There is no analysis for third parties and no quiet copy.
privacy.deletion: And when you delete a meeting it is really gone, audio, transcript and minutes with it. There is deliberately no trash it comes back from.

legal.pending: This page has not been written yet. As soon as the text exists, it will be here.

consent.title: Before you record
consent.body: You are responsible for informing all participants that this meeting is being recorded, and for obtaining any consent required where you are. Quorum cannot notify participants outside this app.
consent.confirm: I have informed the participants — start recording
consent.confirmOnline: I have informed the participants — share and start recording
consent.bodyOnline: You are responsible for informing everyone in the call that this meeting is being recorded, and for obtaining any consent required where you are. Quorum cannot notify the other participants — say it in the call.

recording.title: New recording
recording.noAudio: No audio detected — check your microphone.
recording.wakeLockUnsupported: This browser cannot keep the screen awake. Recording continues if the screen turns off, but keep the tab open.

titleField.label: Meeting title
titleField.placeholder: Optional — you can add it later

inputField.label: Microphone
inputField.forgotten: The microphone you used last is not connected. This recording uses the system default.

recording.inputFallback: Your microphone was disconnected — recording continues on the system default.

sync.saving: Saving your recording… ({{seconds}}s still on this device)
sync.unstable: Connection unstable — {{seconds}}s still on this device

banner.offline: Offline — recording continues, your audio is safe on this device ({{seconds}}s buffered)
banner.storage: Device storage is almost full. Reconnect so the buffered audio can upload.

error.permission-denied: Quorum needs access to your microphone to record. Allow it in your browser and try again.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
error.storage: The recording was stopped because audio could not be stored on this device.
error.connection: The connection failed. Your audio is safe on this device.
error.input-lost: The recording stopped because no microphone is available any more. Everything captured so far is safe on this device.
error.display-denied: Quorum needs the sound of your meeting to record an online meeting. Nothing was shared, so nothing was recorded. Try again and pick the meeting window or your screen.
error.display-no-audio: That share carried no sound, so the recording was not started. Share again and tick “Also share tab audio” or “Share system audio” in the browser's dialog. If your browser offers no such option, record this meeting in person instead.
error.display-unsupported: This browser cannot capture the sound of another app. Use Chrome or Edge on Windows or macOS 14.2 or newer, or record this meeting in person.

recovery.title: A recording was interrupted
recovery.body: Audio from {{date}} is still on this device and has not been saved yet.

holdToStop.label: Stop recording — press and hold
holdToStop.armed: Press again to stop the recording

mode.label: What kind of meeting is this?

in-person.label: In person
in-person.note: Records the microphone — everyone in the room, on one input.

online.label: Online meeting
online.note: Records the microphone together with the sound of the meeting app on this computer. Your browser will ask which window or screen to share, and to tick “Also share tab audio” or “Share system audio”. Quorum takes only the sound: the picture is discarded the instant the share begins and is never recorded, stored or transmitted.
online.unsupported: This browser cannot capture the sound of another app. Use Chrome or Edge on Windows or macOS 14.2 or newer. On this browser you can still record an in-person meeting, or play the call through your speakers and record it with the microphone.

recording.displayEnded: The shared sound stopped — the recording is paused and everything so far is safe. Share again to carry on, or stop to keep what you have.

limits.sessionDuration: This recording reached the maximum length and was stopped. Everything up to that point is finalized and safe — transcript and summary follow as usual.
limits.sessionLifetime: This recording was open for a very long time and was closed for you. Everything recorded is finalized and safe — transcript and summary follow as usual.
limits.pauseDuration: The recording stayed paused for a long time, so it was finished for you. Everything up to the pause is finalized and safe — start a new recording to carry on.
limits.parallelSessions: You already have as many recordings running as your account allows. Stop one of them, then start this one again.
limits.sendRate: The connection was closed because audio arrived faster than allowed. What is still on this device can be uploaded from the meetings screen.
limits.storageQuota: Your storage is full, so this recording could not be started. Delete a meeting you no longer need to free space.
limits.monthlyQuota: You have used your recording time for this month, so this recording could not be started. The allowance resets at the start of next month.
limits.requestRate: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.

meetings.title: Meetings

empty.title: Your first meeting awaits
empty.body: Record it here — transcript and summary follow on their own.

meetings.loadError: Your meetings could not be loaded.

delete.title: Delete this meeting?
delete.body: “{{meeting}}” and everything derived from it will be permanently deleted: the audio recording, all transcripts, and all summaries. This cannot be undone.

howItWorks.title: How Quorum works
howItWorks.intro: Three steps — you only do the first one.

record.title: Record
record.body: Your audio is saved as you record, so a closed tab or a dropped connection costs you nothing.

transcribe.title: Transcribe
transcribe.body: Speech recognition turns the recording into text you can read, search and jump around in.

summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.body: Templates decide what a summary contains. Shape them the way your team works.

templates.title: Templates
templates.unsetDefault: Default — stop using {{template}} for new recordings

deleteDialog.title: Delete this template?
deleteDialog.body: “{{template}}” will be permanently deleted. Summaries already written with it are not affected: each one keeps its own copy of the template it was made with. This cannot be undone.

templates.loadError: Your templates could not be loaded.
templates.saveFailed: This template could not be saved.

empty.title: Summaries, your way
empty.body: Start from the system template and shape the sections you actually need.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameHelp: Give this template a name you'll recognize later.
editor.languageHelp: Following the recording keeps a meeting's summary in the language it was held in.
editor.sectionsHelp: Each section becomes a heading in the summary, written from what you ask for under it.
editor.sectionsRequired: Keep at least one section — a summary with none has nothing to say.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.label: Language of new recordings
transcription.help: Every recording can be set to another language before it starts.
transcription.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Your recordings, transcripts and summaries stay in your account.
